courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Let's first of all have a look at which kind of performance we need in this app
and there, we'll have the authentication form,
I got this single e-mail input here.
Now obviously, I'm not just interested in fetching the e-mail,
I also want to get a password and I want to allow the user to switch between the sign-up and login
so that is one thing we'll have to work on.
Then we also can book places,
so here on that booking modal which we can open in two different ways with our own custom date being
selected or a random date already filled in,
so in this modal, I want to allow the user to enter some booking data and for example, select the date
range for which you want to book that place.
Now last but not least, on offers, we can of course add a new offer here.
So currently I have my grid playground there, that is of course not what we'll leave here,
instead here I want to have a nice form that we can use to create a new offer,
so a new place we want offer to be precise.
This is what I want to add here in this application, three different forms,
I will use both the template-driven and the reactive forms approach in this module and therefore let's
dive in and let's actually start with the authentication form here.
